title: Imperial Storm
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought the situation had reached an impasse, a familiar voice that made his spine chill came from outside the hall—the voice's owner was actually an old acquaintance who should have died in the Ancient Forbidden Land twenty years ago.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul gradually solidified in the light, and in those eyes that had seen through the ages, an emotion Chen Ji had never seen before finally appeared. Guilt. It was guilt. Chen Ji's heart tightened—for an existence of this level to feel guilt, it could only be a major matter. 'Master, speak freely if you have something to say.' He suppressed the turmoil in his heart, his voice almost coldly calm. Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, his remnant soul trembling slightly before finally speaking: 'When I passed the Tianji Record Fragment to Chen Xuan back then, it was a move... that I had no choice but to make.' His gaze fell on Chen Ji's face, 'I just didn't expect this chess game to pull you into it as well.' Before his words even finished, three dull bells rang outside the hall—the signal of the Dynasty envoys' arrival. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul instantly dissipated, leaving only one sentence echoing in Chen Ji's ear: 'Be careful with the visitor—a complete Heavenly Secrets Stage, not someone you can defeat now.'

dialogue.content: 'Elder Chen, the Dynasty envoy is waiting in the main hall, please come.' Ling Yuan's voice came from outside the door, unhurried, yet carrying a hint of barely detectable schadenfreude. Chen Ji straightened his clothes and pushed the door open, directly meeting Ling Yuan's deep and unfathomable eyes. The old man's expression was as kind as ever, but Chen Ji clearly saw the slightly trembling fingers hidden in the other's sleeve—a sign of restrained excitement. 'Senior Uncle, it seems the Dynasty highly values the Tianqing Sect.' Chen Ji said calmly. Ling Yuan stroked his beard with a smile: 'Indeed, the envoy said there was important business to discuss, though the specifics... were not disclosed.' His eyes were meaningful, 'Elder Chen, you must tread carefully.'

text.content: In the main hall, over a hundred disciples stood in lines on both sides, the atmosphere so oppressive it was suffocating. The moment Chen Ji stepped through the hall door, he felt an oppressive pressure like a mountain pressing down from the seat at the head. A complete Heavenly Secrets Stage. His heart tightened. He looked up—the envoy sat in a rosewood chair, wearing a black official robe, his face obscured by a layer of light spiritual energy, making his specific features indistinguishable, but that oppressive pressure genuinely declared the visitor's terrifying cultivation. Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect, stood behind this person, his gaze toward Chen Ji filled with provocation and glee. 'Chen Ji, servant disciple of Tianqing Sect,' the envoy spoke, his voice genderless, 'or should I address you as... Grand Preceptor Chen, the Crown Prince's Teacher?' He laughed lightly, 'What an impressive air you have.' The hall erupted in whispers.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji neither bowed nor flattered, saluting with cupped hands: 'This humble official Chen Ji greets the Celestial Envoy.' The envoy raised his hand, the spiritual energy slightly rippling: 'Rise. This envoy comes only to convey a verbal decree from the Dynasty—' He paused, his voice suddenly turning cold, 'From this day forward, Chen Ji's position as Crown Prince's Teacher is suspended, pending investigation.' The hall fell deathly silent. Han Lie's lips could barely suppress the rising curve of his smile. Ling Yuan sighed beside him, though a gleam flashed in his eyes. Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but his mind was already racing: Tianji Pavilion's methods were faster and more ruthless than he had anticipated. 'May I ask, Celestial Envoy, what crimes does this humble official commit?' he asked calmly. The envoy sneered: 'Secretly hoarding forbidden objects, practicing demonic arts, disrupting moral order... are these charges enough?'

text.content: Secretly hoarding forbidden objects? Practicing demonic arts? Chen Ji inwardly sneered. He knew these were trumped-up charges—what Tianji Pavilion wanted was the Tianji Record, that power capable of foresight. But on the surface, he maintained that weak and humble appearance, his body trembling slightly, his voice weak and虚: 'Celestial... Celestial Envoy, please investigate clearly. This humble official is merely a servant disciple, how could I secretly hoard forbidden objects? There must be a misunderstanding here...' When he said this, he seemed to be so frightened that his legs went soft, nearly falling to his knees. Someone in the hall immediately showed disdain—this good-for-nothing is indeed a good-for-nothing, frightened like this at the first sign of trouble. Han Lie was even more blatant in his derisive laughter: 'So the grand Crown Prince's Teacher is nothing but this kind of trash.' The envoy also showed a satisfied expression, just about to pronounce more charges when suddenly, a change occurred—hurried footsteps sounded outside the hall.

dialogue.content: 'Wait!' Han Lie suddenly stepped forward, proclaiming loudly, 'Thistrash Chen Ji, relying on his Crown Prince's Teacher identity to act arbitrarily and bully fellow disciples, the entire Xuanwu Sect has long been simmering with resentment. Now that the Dynasty wants to settle accounts with this villain, why not let me teach him a lesson first for the Celestial Envoy, so he knows the heights of heaven and the depths of earth!' As he spoke, his aura suddenly erupted, Xuanwu True Intent coiling around him like a fire dragon, disciples of lower cultivation in the hall retreating in succession. Ling Yuan's brow furrowed slightly, but he made no move to stop. The envoy glanced meaningfully at Han Lie, saying casually: 'If Young Hero Han is inclined, this envoy would like to see what abilities thistrash has.' Han Lie grinned wickedly, striding toward Chen Ji with each step carrying oppressive momentum, 'trash, today is your death!'

text.content: Chen Ji still wore that shivering appearance, but his divine sense was racing. Han Lie—Tianwu Stage, combat power against the heavens, a frontal clash would be certain death. But this person was simple-minded, brave but foolish, his biggest weakness. He quietly activated the Tianji Record Fragment, a blurry image flashing through his mind—three breaths later, Han Lie's right fist would attack his left ribs. Opportunity only comes once; if he could counter, he could shock the entire audience; if he failed... His eyes darkened slightly, but his face showed even more terror, 'H-Han, Young Hero Han, spare my life...' Han Lie, upon hearing this, grew even more pleased, his fist already filled with Xuanwu True Intent. In the instant he was about to throw the punch, Chen Ji's eyes suddenly changed—

text.content: The instant Han Lie's right fist burst out, Chen Ji's body suddenly sank, dodging sideways at an incredible angle, while his left hand transformed from palm to fist, precisely smashing into Han Lie's left ribs—the exact spot where he had originally intended to attack Chen Ji. 'Bang!' The muffled sound shook the great hall, Han Lie's massive body was actually knocked back three steps by this punch, a surge of qi and blood churning in his chest, his face full of disbelief. 'You... how could you—' His voice was trembling. The hall fell into dead silence, everyone staring with wide eyes—was this servant disciple, the one calledtrash, actually punches retreating Xuanwu Sect's number one genius?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji withdrew his fist, that terrified expression on his face already gone, replaced by a faint smile. He brushed off non-existent dust from his sleeves, saying unhurriedly: 'Young Hero Han, I thank you for your generosity. Your move 'Xuanwu Tail Sweep,' the lower stance work still needs more polish. If you have free time in the future, this humble official could give you some pointers.' These words were spoken lightly, yet they landed like a loud slap on Han Lie's face. Xuanwu Sect's number one genius being 'given pointers' by atrash? Han Lie trembled with rage, 'You—you cheated!' Chen Ji innocently spread his hands: 'This humble official is merely a servant disciple, what ability could I possibly have? Young Hero Han must be joking?'

text.content: Han Lie's fist, carrying Xuanwu True Intent, slammed down. Chen Ji did not dodge, did not even block—he simply took the hit with his fleshly body, a blow that could split mountains and shatter rocks. 'Pfft!' Blood sprayed out, Chen Ji's body flew backward like a broken kite, crashing heavily against the hall pillar, sliding to the ground with a face ashen as gold paper and barely breathing. The hall erupted in chaos, 'Murder!' 'The Dynasty Celestial Envoy is abetting his subordinate in violence!' Shouts of alarm rose on all sides. The envoy's expression instantly darkened, Han Lie also froze—he hadn't expected Chen Ji to truly not dodge or block. Ling Yuan's brow was tightly furrowed, feeling something was wrong somewhere, yet unable to pinpoint it.

dialogue.content: Lying in a pool of blood, a faint arc was curling at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth that others could hardly detect. He trembling raised his hand, pointing at Han Lie, weakly uttering a few words: 'H-Han... Young Hero Han is so imposing... In front of the Dynasty Celestial Envoy... beating an... innocent person...' Each word seemed to have taken all his strength, yet every word pierced the heart. The hall immediately buzzed with discussion, 'So the Crown Prince's Teacher was truly framed!' 'Is the Dynasty trying to eliminate everyone?' The envoy's expression grew more and more unsightly—he hadn't expected thistrash to have such scheming—willing to damage himself a thousand, just to harm the enemy eight hundred.

choices.text: Reveal Crown Prince's Teacher identity to dominate the scene
choices.description: Publicly displaying the prince's personally bestowed token, questioning in an official capacity whether the envoy has the authority to bypass the imperial court and directly punish the prince's close minister, escalating the conflict.
choices.visible_cost: Completely offend the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion of the imperial court, endless troubles ahead.
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily preserve one's position, gaining a moment to catch one's breath.

choices.process_label: chen ji reaches for token ready to strike

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up straight, the cowardice and terror from moments before seemingly non-existent. From his embrace, he produced a dragon-patterned jade pendant, raising it aloft, his voice cold: "This is the prince's personally bestowed token! Seeing this pendant is like seeing His Highness himself!" The Jade Pendant glittered under the Spiritual Light's illumination, a majestic royal aura spreading outward. The envoy's pupils contracted sharply—this was indeed an authentic princely token, and he had no authority to当场处置持有此物之人. Han Lie's face changed dramatically, the royal aura exerting a natural suppression on his Xuanwu True Intent. Ling Yuan's eyes flickered with a trace of apprehension—this waste... actually had such a trump card?

dialogue.content: "If Your Envoy wishes to bring charges against me," Chen Ji's voice was no longer humble, carrying an undeniable authority, "please first report to His Highness the Prince. Once His Highness's decree arrives, this official will personally go to the imperial court to accept punishment. But before the Prince's decree arrives—" His gaze was like a blade, fixed directly on the envoy, "this official remains the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor of this Zhou dynasty. Your actions are somewhat disrespectful to His Highness, don't you think?" This accusation was extremely heavy; the envoy's expression flickered betweengloomy and uncertain. Behind him was the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, no doubt, but the Crown Prince was after all the heir apparent. If this matter reached the Emperor, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion might not necessarily gain an advantage.

text.content: The atmosphere in the hall solidified like ice. The envoy's Spiritual Pressure continued to rise, yet failed to break this "waste" standing before him. He scrutinized Chen Ji properly for the first time, a sense of unease rising in his heart—this young man was far from being as simple as he appeared. He took a deep breath, suppressing his restlessness, and said coldly: "Very well, very good. Since Master Chen invokes the princely token, I shall give you this face today." He rose, sweeping his sleeves, "But remember this—the things the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion desires have never been unobtainable. This matter... is not over." With that, he turned and left. Han Lie glared at Chen Ji resentfully but could only follow. Ling Yuan stood rooted to the spot, his gaze complex as he looked at Chen Ji, seeming to want to speak yet ultimately only sighing as he departed. Those present in the hall exchanged glances—today's drama had truly exceeded everyone's expectations.

dialogue.content: After the crowd dispersed, Chen Ji slowly exhaled a foul breath. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested once more, his expression even more grave than before: "Do you know what background the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion has?" Chen Ji shook his head. Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion is a secret organization secretly supported by the imperial court, dedicated to collecting prophetic treasures and techniques from across the world. The Tianji Record... is precisely what they are determined to obtain." His voice was low, "Those within the pavilion are all experts at the Heavenly Secrets realm and above, and it is said... the Pavilion Master himself has already reached the realm of Half-Step Heaven-Traversing." Chen Ji's heart tightened. Half-Step Heaven-Traversing? That exceeded his understanding of this world. Mo Xiansheng continued: "They will not let this matter rest. You escaped today, but next time... it probably won't be so easy."

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back in the hall, his gaze profound. He had taken Mo Xiansheng's words to heart, but he was not panicked. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion wanted the Tianji Record? Fine, let them come for it. As long as he remained on this chessboard, nothing was unusable. The only thing he feared was that legendary Pavilion Master—a Half-Step Heaven-Traversing existence, a gap that could no longer be bridged by intelligence alone. "Master," he suddenly spoke, "you said that prophetic seers throughout history were used as chess pieces... what role does the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion play in this?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, as if touching upon some taboo topic, yet ultimately simply shook his head: "Now is not the time to speak of this. You only need to remember one thing—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of fate." This sentence again. Chen Ji furrowed his brows; he always felt that Mo Xiansheng was hiding some crucial information.

Just then, commotion arose outside the hall. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, and before he could send someone to investigate, an Inner Disciple stumbled in, face ashen: "M-Master Chen! A group of people has arrived outside the Sect Gate, the leader calls himself... the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion Pavilion Master!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. How fast. He had just sent away the envoy, thinking he could at least gain several days of respite, but he hadn't expected the Pavilion Master himself to come directly. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a low sigh: "What was meant to come... has finally arrived." Chen Ji took a deep breath, straightened his robes, and strode out of the hall. Whoever was coming, he had to face them personally—this was his destiny as a chess player.

Outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, a figure stood with hands clasped behind his back, surrounded by faint starlight, as if stepped out of the primordial chaos. His features were identical to the portrait left by Chen Tianming twenty years ago, yet added with a few degrees of vicissitudes and majesty. Chen Ji's steps halted, his gaze firmly fixed on the newcomer. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying an unprecedented tremor: "It's him... it really is him..." An ocean of shock surged in Chen Ji's heart—Mo Xiansheng knew this person? Who exactly was this person? The figure with hands clasped behind his back slowly turned around; those eyes seemed to have witnessed the wear of millennia, yet also contained endless profound meaning. He looked at Chen Ji, the corners of his lips slightly rising: "The descendant of Chen Tian, truly extraordinary." His voice was gentle yet carried irresistible pressure, "Your grandfather and I were once fellow disciples."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the surging shock in his heart, maintaining composure on the surface: "Since the elder was a fellow disciple with my grandfather, how should I address you?" The person smiled lightly, yet the smile carried indescribably complex emotions: "You may call me... Senior Uncle-Patriarch." He stepped forward, starlight surging with him, "My name is Chen Tianming." Chen Tianming—the name exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. This name he had seen countless times in the incomplete records left by Mo Xiansheng, yet he never imagined he would one day see its owner in person. Tianming, fate... could his name have already foretold today's encounter? Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time carrying deep weariness and helplessness: "Everything should end... or rather, everything is just beginning."

text.content: Chen Tianming's gaze fell upon Chen Ji, as if looking at a treasured object regained after loss, yet also as if looking at a predestined opponent: "The Tianji Record chose you—this is both your fortune and your misfortune." He raised his hand, starlight condensing into an ancient token between his fingers, "This is my connection to the Tianji Record—or rather, the sin I personally created." The token slowly drifted toward Chen Ji, yet he dared not reach out to take it. Chen Tianming, seeing this, was not angry, merely saying calmly: "No need to be nervous. Today, I did not come to take your life." His gaze deepened, "On the contrary... I came to repay a debt." Repay a debt? Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly—what debt could an extraordinary expert at the Half-Step Heaven-Traversing realm possibly owe to a mere Foundation Building cultivator like himself?

Among the distant mountain ranges, several concealed auras watched from the shadows. Ling Yuan stood above the clouds, his expression gloomy enough to drip water— he had never expected Chen Tianming to appear personally, nor that this person would have such a connection with Chen Ji. Han Lie stood behind him, grinding his teeth: "Master, what exactly is that waste's background? Why would even the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion Pavilion Master..." Ling Yuan raised his hand to silence him, his voice ice-cold: "Shut up. You only need to know one thing—from today onward, this boy Chen Ji must die." A fierce light flashed in his eyes, "Regardless of who stands behind him, regardless of what background he has—the future of the Tianqing Sect cannot be handed to an outsider." Han Lie nodded vigorously, his Xuanwu True Intent surging in his palm, killing intent chilling.

Chen Tianming stood with hands clasped behind his back, starlight flowing around him as if forming a world of its own. He looked at Chen Ji, and an uncommon warmth actually appeared in his eyes: "Do you know who the original master of the Tianji Record was?" Chen Ji shook his head. Chen Tianming sighed softly: "It was me." These two simple words exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. The original master of the Tianji Record... was actually him? Then the current Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, the predestined chess piece fate of prophetic seers throughout history, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul guardianship... everything became clear. A bitter smile appeared on Chen Tianming's face: "I split the Tianji Record into three parts and scattered them across the mortal world, intending to sever this karmic connection, yet I never expected... fate plays tricks, and it ultimately found you."

Chen Tianming slowly raised his hand, a strand of starlight sinking into Chen Ji's Brow Center. In an instant, countless images flashed by like a carousel—he saw Chen Tianming's youthful ambition and vigor, the spectacular omens when the Tianji Record was first completed, the fierce battle that caused the Tianji Record to shatter... and also how Mo Xiansheng, with his remnant soul form, protected the last wisp of Heavenly Secrets power, sending it into the Chen family's bloodline. "Master..." Chen Ji murmured; he finally understood the source of Mo Xiansheng's guilt. Mo Xiansheng was not对不起他, but对不起 Chen Tianming— the thing he protected with his remnant soul was precisely the karmic connection that Chen Tianming had personally buried. Chen Tianming withdrew his hand, his gaze profound: "From today onward, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion will no longer trouble you. But there is one condition—"

dialogue.content: "What condition?" Chen Ji askedsaid in a deep voice. Chen Tianming stared directly into his eyes, saying word by word: "When the Heavenly Dao ruins open in three months, you must enter, find that thing, and seal it." His voice suddenly turned凌厉, "Otherwise, within three years, this continent will turn to scorched earth." Chen Ji's heart tightened. Heavenly Dao ruins? Seal that thing? The things involved here far exceeded his imagination. Just as he was about to probe further, Chen Tianming had already turned around, starlight gathering beneath his feet: "More truths need you to excavate yourself. The only thing I can tell you is—" His figure began to dissipate, "The Eye of Heavenly Dao has always been watching you. From the moment you obtained the Tianji Record... it has been watching you."

text.content: Chen Tianming's figure completely dissipated, leaving only漫天星光 slowly falling, like shooting stars descending. Chen Ji stood in place, long speechless. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested once more; this time, his form was several degrees more凝实 than before: "You heard it. The Eye of Heavenly Dao... that is an existence beyond everything." Chen Ji turned his head, his gaze like a blade: "Master, how many things have you been hiding from me?" Mo Xiansheng was silent. Silence was the best answer. Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions in his heart. The crisis with the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion was temporarily resolved, but the choice he faced had become even more difficult—would the Heavenly Dao ruins three months later be an opportunity or a trap? And what exactly was that "Eye of Heavenly Dao" that had always been secretly watching him?

Mo Xiansheng continued: "In ancient times, Chen Tianming and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets were born from the same source—one representing the will of Heavenly Dao, the other representing the struggles of mortals against fate beneath Heaven's gaze. The Tianji Record... was the product of the collision between these two forces." His gaze grew distant, "And you, Chen Ji, are the only descendant carrying both bloodlines. The Tianji Record choosing you is no coincidence, but... inevitability." Chen Ji felt his mind explode with countless fragments piecing together into a chilling truth.

text.content: Chen Ji did not press Mo Xiansheng further, but turned to gaze in the direction where Ling Yuan had departed. He had not missed Ling Yuan's expression changes when Chen Tianming appeared—that momentary shock, followed by wariness, and finally a killing intent... too fake. A normal sect elder seeing such a powerful figure appear should feel reverence, not killing intent. Unless... Ling Yuan and Chen Tianming share some unspeakable grudge. He quietly activated the Tianji Record, and a blurry image emerged—three days later at midnight, Ling Yuan would secretly meet a black-robed figure. Though the image was blurred, that black-robed figure's aura... Chen Ji narrowed his eyes. It was someone from the Tianji Pavilion.

dialogue.content: Fine Ling Yuan, daring to secretly collude with the Tianji Pavilion. A cold smile curled at Chen Ji's lips. He had thought Ling Yuan merely coveted the Sect Master position, but now it seemed this man's ambitions went far beyond that. He quietly left a spiritual mark in the Tianji Record, locking onto Ling Yuan's aura. Three days later at midnight, he would see exactly what this old sect master was scheming. Upon seeing this, Mo Xiansheng gave a slight nod: "You can keep your composure,不被 curiosity clouding your judgment... good. This is the mindset a chess player should have." Chen Ji said calmly: "Flattery from Master. I simply... remember grudges." His gaze turned deep, "Whatever Ling Yuan owes me, I will collect it one by one."

text.content: Chen Ji returned to his meditation chamber, sitting cross-legged. He had taken Mo Xiansheng's words to heart—Heavenly Secrets relic, the sealed object, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets... all of this required strength as foundation. Without strength, all strategy is meaningless. He took a deep breath, guiding spiritual energy to circulate through his meridians. The Tianji Record Fragment in his dantian glowed faintly, emanating a profound aura that actually helped him unblock meridians and accelerate cultivation. "This is..." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of surprise, "The Tianji Record is actively matching your cultivation. It's helping you." Chen Ji's heart stirred—this was the first time feeling the Tianji Record's "kindness." Could it be because Chen Tianming unsealed something?

Seven days later, Chen Ji opened his eyes. A robust aura surged from within him—late Foundation Building stage, only one step from Golden Core. "So fast?" Even he was surprised. Mo Xiansheng pondered: "It's the effect of Chen Tianming's starlight... he left a trace of origin power within you, helping you accelerate your breakthrough." Chen Ji frowned—what was Chen Tianming's true purpose in helping him? Simply to have him seal that object? He felt this matter wasn't that simple. But regardless, strength improvement was always good. Standing up, feeling the surging power within, his lips curved slightly upward: "Ling Yuan, Han Lie... three months from now, I will make you understand what regret means."

Just as Chen Ji was沉浸在 breakthrough joy, urgent knocking came from outside the hall. "Lord Chen! Lord Chen!" It was Su Qingyao's voice, carrying rare panic. Chen Ji frowned slightly, stood, and opened the door. Su Qingyao's face was pale, eyes full of anxiety: "Something happened! Inner Disciple Li Yunpeng... he was murdered!" Chen Ji's gaze sharpened: "Any clues at the scene?" Su Qingyao took a deep breath: "Yes. His hand was clutching a jade slip, engraved with... your name." Her gaze at Chen Ji held genuine suspicion for the first time. Chen Ji's heart sank—someone wanted to frame him, and he didn't even know who the opponent was. This chess game was far more complex than he imagined.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stared intently into Chen Ji's eyes, as if trying to find any flaw: "Li Yunpeng was Ling Yuan's personal disciple, his death... could never be an accident." Her voice was soft, yet carried a tremor, "Chen Ji, I'm asking you one last time—does this matter involve you?" Chen Ji met her gaze, expression calm: "Does Senior Sister Su think, if I had done this, would I be foolish enough to leave my own name?" Su Qingyao was stunned, then fell into contemplation. Indeed, the framing was too crude,反而显得刻意. Chen Ji continued: "Someone wants to use a borrowed knife, causing Ling Yuan and me to彻底反目." His gaze deepened, "And this person... is probably right beside us."

text.content: Chen Ji picked up the jade slip, his spiritual sense probing within, only to find the information had been erased. "Ruthless." Hesneered一声, "Murder and silencing, frame-up, evidence destruction... seamless,滴水不漏." Su Qingyao watched his reaction, her doubts gradually fading. She suddenly remembered: "By the way, Li Yunpeng had consulted an ancient text in the scripture library before his death—about the records of 'Destiny's Lock Key.'" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Destiny's Lock Key... that was Chen Nian—his missing sister for years. How could she be connected to this matter? A premonition of doom surged in his heart, and without time to explain, he turned and flew toward the scripture library.

dialogue.content: In the scripture library, Chen Ji searched through all texts about "Destiny's Lock Key," finding only scattered words—"Destiny's Lock Key can open the gate of Heavenly Secrets, reverse the wheel of destiny. Since ancient times, only one bloodline can bear this responsibility..." The following content was deliberately torn away, leaving only a charred corner with a faint "Chen" character visible. Chen Ji's hands trembled slightly. Chen Nian... his sister... she was not simply missing, but deliberately taken as a key to open some forbidden formation. "Who?" His voice was low like an abyss, "Who took her?" Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind,带着一丝hesitated: "It was the Holy Sect... but the true mastermind is the Eye of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content: Chen Ji stood in the scripture library, clutching the yellowed fragment. Destiny's Lock Key, Chen Nian, Heavenly Secrets relic... these clues were slowly connecting into a terrifying truth. His sister might have been entangled in this chess game from the very beginning. And he thought he was the one setting up the world—unaware that from start to finish, he was merely a piece on the board, pushed forward by fate, never seeing the full picture of the Chess Player. "Chen Tianming said the Eye of Heavenly Secrets has always been watching me..." he murmured, "What does it want?" Outside the window, night deepened, and Tianqing Sect fell into an eerie silence. No one knew that on this peaceful night, the prelude to the storm had already begun. And Chen Ji, standing at fate's crossroads, felt a trace of... confusion for the first time.

At that moment, a black shadow silently appeared at the scripture library entrance. Chen Ji turned sharply, only to see the figure remove their hood, revealing a face that surprised him—Ye Qing. The Demon Path Saint's face was pale now, eyes carrying rare urgency: "Chen Ji, the Holy Sect is going to strike at you." She lowered her voice, "They know you've uncovered the Destiny's Lock Key matter... Li Yunpeng, they killed him." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes: "You came to tell me this, wanting to cooperate with me?" Ye Qing forced a smile: "I just don't want to watch the only person capable of opposing the Eye of Heavenly Secrets... die by their hands." Her gaze fell on the fragment in Chen Ji's hand, "I can tell you where Chen Nian is, but you must答应我一件事—"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing took a deep breath, eyes flashing with determination: "Take me with you, to the Heavenly Secrets relic." Chen Ji remained silent for a moment: "Do you know what that means?" Ye Qing nodded: "I know. The Holy Sect controlled me for over a decade, I'm fed up." Her voice carriedsuppressed的恨意, "I want to personally destroy that prison... even if it costs my life." Chen Ji looked at her, suddenly thinking of his own sister. Did Chen Nian also, on some late night, desperately wish for someone to extend a helping hand? He closed his eyes briefly, then opened them again, gaze already restored to clarity: "Fine. But before that, we need to solve one problem first—" A cold smile curled at his lips, "Ling Yuan's dealings with the Holy Sect."

text.content: Three days later at midnight, windless and dark. Chen Ji hid in the shadows outside Ling Yuan's chambers, Ye Qing concealed on the other side masking their auras. His spiritual sense locked onto the hall—inside, Ling Yuan was in secret discussion with a black-robed figure. "...Chen Ji cannot be allowed to live." Ling Yuan's voice carried urgency, "He possesses the Tianji Record Fragment and has connections with Chen Tianming. If we let him grow stronger, the consequences would be unimaginable." The black-robed figure gave a raspy laugh: "Rest assured, Sect Master Ling. The Holy Lord has already sent the 'Heart-Slayer Envoy.' Within three days, Chen Ji will certainly be dead." Chen Ji's eyes flashed—Heart-Slayer Envoy? Another unfamiliar name. He silently recorded it, continuing to listen. Ling Yuan sighed: "It's just that we haven't found that girl yet... Destiny's Lock Key is the key."

So that's how it is. Chen Ji's heart turned ice cold. Ling Yuan wasn't merely coveting the Sect Master position—he was a pawn of the Holy Sect! For years, Tianqing Sect's decline, his suppression, even Chen Nian's disappearance... all were connected to this person. He took a deep breath, suppressing the killing intent surging within. Now was not the time to act—Ling Yuan was merely the visible enemy, the true mastermind was the Holy Sect, was the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. He silently retreated from the shadows, returning to his meditation chamber. Ye Qing was waiting there: "Heard it?" Chen Ji nodded, taking out a jade slip from his chest, carving several runes: "This is evidence of Ling Yuan's treason. At the Sect Competition three days later, I will publicly expose his true colors."

Ye Qing took the jade slip, examining it carefully: "You trust me so easily? Not afraid I'm a spy from the Holy Sect?" Chen Ji said calmly: "If you wanted to harm me, you had countless opportunities just now." He paused, "Besides... we're both pieces manipulated by fate. Rather than fighting separately, better to join forces and take one gamble." Ye Qing stared at him blankly, then suddenly smiled—that smile carried a hint of relief: "Chen Ji, you truly are different from others. No wonder the Eye of Heavenly Secrets fears you so much." She put away the jade slip, expression turning serious, "The Heart-Slayer Envoy's methods are extremely bizarre, specializing in soul attacks. If you want to defend against them, you must strike first." Chen Ji nodded: "I understand." He turned to gaze out the window, eyes reflecting the countless stars above, "Ling Yuan, just wait... at the Sect Competition three days later, I will let you understand what it means... heaven's justice is inescapable, and karma always returns."

As Chen Ji was plotting his counterattack three days later, far away in the depths of a royal dynasty thousands of miles away, within a palace concealed by layers of forbidden formations, a consciousness slowly awakened. "Chen Tianming... have you finally made your move?" The voice of that will was ancient and cold, as if emanating from the primordial antiquity itself, "Unfortunately... did you think that separating the Tianji Record would allow you to escape my control?" In the depths of the palace, a pair of eyes slowly opened. Within those pupils, densely packed runes flowed and swirled, resembling the interweaving of countless threads of destiny—the Heavenly Celestial Eye. It murmured softly: "Chen Ji... Chen Nian... interesting. This game of chess grows more and more fascinating." As the words faded, the palace once again fell into deathly silence. And within this silence, a secret regarding the Heavenly Celestial Remnants quietly began to unfold...
